1.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

2.w: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

3.w: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and in understanding and in knowledge and in all [manner of] workmanship,

4.w: to design artistic works, to work in gold and in silver and in bronze,

5.w: and in cutting stone for setting, and in cutting wood, to work in all [manner of] workmanship.

6.w: And I, behold, have appointed with him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And in the hearts of all who are wise of heart, I have put wisdom, and they shall make all that I have commanded you:

7.w: The Tent of Meeting, and the ark of the Testimony, and the mercy seat that [is] on it, and all the vessels of the tent,

8.w: and the table and its vessels, and the pure lampstand and all its vessels, and the altar of incense,

9.w: and the altar of the burnt offering and all its vessels, and the basin and its stand,

10.w: and the woven garments and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons to minister as priests,

11.w: and the anointing oil, and the incense of spice for the Holy Place. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.”

12.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

13.w: “And You, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Truly My Sabbaths you⁺ shall keep, for it [is] a sign between Me and between you⁺ throughout your⁺ generations, that [you] may know that I [am] YHWH who sanctifies you⁺.

14.w: And you⁺ shall keep the Sabbath, for it [is] holy to you⁺. Everyone who profanes [it], he must surely be put to death, for every doer of work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

15.w: Six days work shall be done, and the seventh day [is] a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to YHWH. Every doer of work on the Sabbath day, he must surely be put to death.

16.w: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to do the Sabbath throughout their generations [as] an everlasting covenant.

17.w: It [is] a sign between Me and between the sons of Israel forever; for [in] six days YHWH made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”

18.w: And He gave unto Moses, as He finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
